items.title: AWS emulator runs services locally
items.oneliner: Local AWS API emulator lets you test SDKs and CLIs offline before paying for real cloud resources.

items.title: Private meeting notes run locally
items.oneliner: Open source desktop recorder transcribes meetings locally without bots, offering a private Granola alternative on macOS, Windows, and Linux.

items.title: Time series datasets get one format
items.oneliner: Python data layer standardizes time series datasets so you can build, load, and benchmark temporal models consistently.

items.title: Paint app for coding agents
items.oneliner: Source available 2D editor lets coding agents draw, edit, and animate alongside humans in the same canvas.

items.title: Neovim gets inline assembly views
items.oneliner: Neovim plugin opens Godbolt style assembly in a floating window for C, C++, and Rust optimization work.

items.title: AI text gets a rewrite pass
items.oneliner: Open source CLI rewrites AI generated prose in two passes to reduce obvious tells and improve technical clarity.

items.title: GitHub Actions can be pinned safely
items.oneliner: Hands on guide shows how to lock GitHub Actions by commit hash and verify lockfiles in CI.

items.title: Astro generates Open Graph cards
items.oneliner: Step by step workflow uses Typst and Astro to generate branded Open Graph images automatically at build time.

items.title: SSH keys move into Secure Enclave
items.oneliner: Practical macOS walkthrough stores SSH keys in Secure Enclave so private material never lands on disk or memory.

items.title: Bots trigger their own ban
items.oneliner: Practical Fail2Ban and nftables setup bans abusive crawlers using signed honeypot links that resist spoofed reports.
